first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and memory_86 directly supports simplifying onboarding as a lever for completion, time-to-value, and early adoption. Verify it to assess whether gains translated into qualified revenue or durable retention. Also verify memory_73 because promotional pricing is the strongest competing response, but its pooled-cohort caveat and uncertain downstream customer quality make the archived record important before committing. Current intent favors fixing the product funnel over potentially subsidizing low-quality acquisition.
